FIELDS.NAME: Optical Emporium
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, 123 Optical Lane, Suite 100, Cityville, CA 90210-1234, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@opticalemporium.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Optical Emporium specializes in the retail sale of optical frames, lenses, and accessories. Our operations include providing high-quality eyewear products and exceptional customer service, ensuring all staff involved in optical fitting and dispensing are appropriately licensed and trained. We maintain a limited in-house laboratory focused solely on lens edging and minor frame repairs, adhering to industry safety standards to minimize operational risks. Our store is equipped with a well-maintained security system to protect our inventory, and we implement documented quality assurance protocols to ensure product safety. We prioritize customer engagement through recall programs for eye exam follow-ups, enhancing compliance and customer retention. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and adherence to best practices, Optical Emporium stands as a trusted destination for optical needs in the community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 01/15/2023, Cause: Water damage due to a plumbing issue, Amount: $2,500.00, Status: Closed
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class 2 Safe, Grade A, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Standard alarm monitoring and on-site security personnel during business hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Optical Emporium does not engage in operations involving storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our focus remains on providing retail optical products and services without handling such materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Optical Emporium does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is primarily on retail optical products and services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by the management team to ensure compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Optical Emporium confirms that no applicant has been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Optical Emporium has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain a strong risk management approach in our operations.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Optical Emporium does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed by the company, ensuring consistent quality and compliance with operational standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Optical Emporium carries Workers' Compensation insurance as part of our commitment to comply with statutory requirements and protect our employees. We maintain an active policy to ensure coverage for workplace-related injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Optical Emporium does not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on the retail sale of optical products and services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Optical Emporium does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. All current coverage is related to our primary operations in retail optical sales.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Optical Emporium is not involved in the manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the retail sale of optical frames, lenses, and accessories with limited in-house lab services restricted to lens edging and minor repairs.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Optical Emporium does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of optical products and services. This policy helps us limit exposure to associated risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Optical Emporium has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial standing remains solid, reflecting the sound management of our operations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Optical Emporium does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in our operations, as we focus solely on retail optical products and services without handling such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Optical Emporium does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused solely on retail optical products and do not involve high-risk activities that could lead to catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Optical Emporium has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to compliance and best practices helps ensure a safe and supportive environment for both employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Optical Emporium has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
